overloads.semanticRole: Assigns a keyboard shortcut to a menu item using a letter/string key (current syntax), optionally combined with extra modifier keys.

discriminatedBy.rule: itemKey is Text: a shortcut letter/string, or an F-key spec like "[F4]".

params.name: menuItem
params.description: Menu item number or -1 for last item added

params.name: itemKey
params.description: Character code of keyboard shortcut (former syntax)

sentinelValues.meaning: Removes any existing shortcut from the menu item.

overloads.semanticRole: Compatibility (former syntax): assigns a keyboard shortcut to a menu item using a raw character code; the shortcut always uses the default Ctrl/Cmd modifier and this form has no way to add extra modifiers.

discriminatedBy.rule: itemKey is Integer: a character code (former syntax); this overload has no modifiers parameter.

constraints: In the primary (Text itemKey) form, the shortcut automatically includes the Ctrl (Windows)/Cmd (macOS) modifier unless itemKey is an F-key spec such as "[F4]", in which case no modifier is added by default; modifiers lets you add extra modifiers (Shift/Option/Command) on top, and 0 means no extra modifiers.
If menu is a MenuRef (16-character alphanumeric), the process parameter serves no purpose and is ignored.
Passing -1 in menuItem designates the last item added to menu.
